visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a medium shot of a man with short, styled black hair and glasses, wearing a clean-pressed black button-down shirt. He stands against a high-contrast nighttime backdrop of the Taipei skyline, dominated by the illuminated Taipei 101 tower. He holds a purple marker and a small black electronic remote, gesturing animatedly while maintaining intense eye contact with the camera to establish immediate engagement. (2) As the man continues his monologue, square graphic overlays appear sequentially over his torso. The first shows a cartoon mosquito with a blood droplet, which then changes to a detailed brown cockroach illustration, and finally transitions to a blue moisture and humidity percentage icon. The lighting remains consistent, highlighting his facial expressions and hand movements as he explains the core concept of the video. (3) The scene cuts to a shot of a wooden interior shelf containing several pairs of shoes. In a following shot, the same shelf is overrun with large, realistic-looking brown and white mushrooms growing directly out of the wood, illustrating the effects of extreme moisture. The man appears in a small inset or background layer, continuing his explanation while these object-focused shots emphasize the damage. (4) Close-up images are displayed showing severe building deterioration. This includes a wall covered in dense black mold, followed by a highly magnified texture of concrete showing its porous, sponge-like structure. The man uses his remote to navigate through these visual aids, pointing towards the screen as yellow and white text captions appear at the top and bottom. (5) New visual evidence is presented: a gray concrete wall featuring thick, white crystalline salt deposits and bubbling, peeling paint known as efflorescence. The man gestures toward a graphic of colorful microscopic organisms, including bacteria and fungi, which are depicted in a grid-like scientific illustration style to explain the biological aspect of 'wall cancer'. (6) The footage transitions to real-world infrastructure damage, showing a massive concrete bridge pillar with significant portions of its outer layer crumbled away, exposing rusted iron rebar underneath. The man explains the chemical reaction occurring within the structure while standing before the Taipei 101 backdrop, which now features a small 'MATRIX' logo and structural health icons. (7) An action sequence begins, showing professional workers wearing safety helmets and harnesses rappelling down a tall building's exterior using ropes. They are seen using high-pressure water jets to blast away dirt, moss, and biological growth from the brick surface. The 'MATRIX' brand logo is prominently featured in a center-screen graphic transition. (8) Detailed shots of the maintenance process follow, including the application of a white primer or sealant over a building's wall. A worker is shown descending a rope next to a large banner for 'CHIN LAN'. The man returns to the full-frame medium shot, summarizing the service benefits while holding his pen and remote. (9) The final phase shows a series of split-screen 'before and after' photographs. On the left, walls are cracked, moldy, and discolored; on the right, the same walls are restored to a pristine, clean, and waterproofed condition. The man concludes his pitch with a final direct address to the camera, gesturing toward the Matrix company name as the video ends.

(3) [Subtitle]: 祂們把我們的衣服變抹布. 把鞋櫃變香菇園. 但這些都是小打小鬧. (4) [Subtitle]: 真正被濕氣上下其手到面目全非的. 其實是這個 房子. (5) [Subtitle]: 房子是很硬. 但在濕氣眼裡也只是塊大一點的吸水海綿. (6) [Subtitle]: 混凝土磚塊裡面有無數的毛細孔. 水分子一看看到心癢癢. (7) [Subtitle]: 靠著毛細作用逆著重力往上爬. 蛤 開除濕機不就好了. (8) [Subtitle]: 那也得濕氣還在空氣裡啊. 一旦鑽進牆體. (9) [Subtitle]: 濕氣就會順便把建材裡的天然鹽分溶解出來. 就算水被吸乾了. (10) [Subtitle]: 鹽巴還是會留在牆面. 長出一層白白的結晶. (16) [Subtitle]: 他們會分泌黏黏的多醣體. 打造防清潔劑的生物膜社群. (17) [Subtitle]: 在裡面安心開趴. 釋放有機酸. (18) [Subtitle]: 把混凝土裡的鈣一點一點啃掉. 讓牆體慢慢粉化. (19) [Subtitle]: 可是壁癌頂多是皮膚病. 生物膜也不過是香港腳. (20) [Subtitle]: 混凝土癌症才是真正的骨癌. (29) [Subtitle]: 到了這一步. 你住的就不再是房子. (30) [Subtitle]: 而是結構鬆散一碰就可能掉屑的水泥千層派. (31) [Subtitle]: 怎麼辦呢. 蛤 就買棟新房子. (32) [Subtitle]: 讓我們務實點. 真正該做的是靠專業的維護. (33) [Subtitle]: 人要定期健康檢查. 房子當然也要.
